system.longDesc: You react to threats instantly and instinctually.

degree0.desc: You can prepare for action in an instant. Once per round on your turn you can use Ready as a free action.

degree1.desc: You can go prone or stand up as a free action rather than as part of a Move action.

degree2.desc: It is hard to get the drop on you. You may re-roll your initiative roll at the start of a combat encounter, but must keep the results of the second roll.
